plans.title: Hyperparameter Optimization Strategy For Expensive Models
plans.objective: Develop a practical decision framework for choosing HPO methods under low, medium, and high evaluation budgets, including multi-fidelity settings.
questions: Which HPO method families are strongest under different budget regimes?
How should search spaces, priors, and early stopping rules be designed to avoid misleading results?
When do multi-fidelity schedulers such as Hyperband, ASHA, BOHB, or population-based training dominate?
What evaluation protocol avoids leakage, lucky seeds, and overfitting to validation feedback?
constraints: Assume evaluations can be expensive and noisy.
Prefer operational guidance a research engineering team can apply.
Make uncertainty explicit where remembered literature details may be incomplete.

plans.title: Accelerator Kernel Design And Autotuning
plans.objective: Map the optimization choices that matter most when designing high-performance GPU or accelerator kernels, including manual design and automated tuning.
questions: Which kernel design levers usually matter most for throughput and latency?
How should tiling, memory layout, vectorization, fusion, and register pressure be balanced?
Where do autotuners, cost models, and compiler schedules help or mislead?
What minimal benchmark protocol should compare kernel variants fairly?
constraints: Focus on CUDA/Triton-like workflows without assuming one specific hardware generation.
Prefer durable principles over vendor-specific trivia.
Call out numerical correctness and maintainability tradeoffs.

plans.title: Optimizer And Schedule Selection For Deep Learning
plans.objective: Create a compact research brief on choosing optimizers, learning-rate schedules, and stability tactics across common deep learning workloads.
questions: When should teams prefer SGD, AdamW, Adafactor-like methods, Lion-like methods, or second-order approximations?
Which learning-rate schedules and warmup choices are robust defaults?
How do batch size, gradient clipping, normalization, and weight decay interact?
What ablations best separate optimizer gains from tuning-budget artifacts?
constraints: Assume teams care about wall-clock, final quality, and reproducibility.
Distinguish training stability from final generalization.
